segments.name: Nut and Bar Products
segments.description: Processes and distributes nuts and bars to food retailers, commercial ingredient users and contract manufacturers.
segments.evidence: We operate in a single reporting unit and operating segment that consists of selling various nut and nut related products and bars through three distribution channels with a similar distribution model.

revenueModel.text: Customers in retail, foodservice and food manufacturing pay for nut and bar products sold through consumer, commercial ingredient and contract manufacturing channels.
revenueModel.evidence: Our products are sold through three core distribution channels, including food retailers in the consumer channel, commercial ingredient users and contract manufacturing customers.
